_comment: Checked-in list of every tool name the stdio server exposes, compared by scripts/verify-tool-names.js against tools/list so a tool added, removed or renamed here cannot drift silently from the hosted connector (Taxually-Einvoicing lib/mcp/tools.ts). Update this file in the same PR as any tool change; when the hosted connector adds or renames a tool, mirror it and move the name between the lists.

stdioOnly.get_br_credentials: Read twin of set_br_credentials; the hosted connector has no read tool.
stdioOnly.poll_br_inbound: Deprecated alias of trigger_br_poll (NF-e only), kept for existing callers.
stdioOnly.refund_tax_calculation: Wraps POST /v1/tax/calculate/{id}/refund; not on the hosted connector yet.
stdioOnly.retry_invoice: Wraps POST /v1/invoices/{id}/retry; not on the hosted connector yet.
stdioOnly.deliver_invoice: Wraps POST /v1/invoices/{id}/deliver; not on the hosted connector yet.
stdioOnly.resend_invoice_notification: Wraps POST /v1/invoices/{id}/resend-notification and the batch route; not on the hosted connector yet.
stdioOnly.delete_product: Wraps DELETE /v1/products/{id}; not on the hosted connector yet.
stdioOnly.restore_product: Wraps POST /v1/tax/products/{id}/restore; not on the hosted connector yet.
stdioOnly.list_tax_obligations: Wraps GET /v1/tax/obligations; not on the hosted connector yet.
stdioOnly.update_tax_obligation: Wraps PATCH /v1/tax/obligations/{id}; not on the hosted connector yet.

hostedOnly.confirm_reporting_batch: Deliberately absent: confirming a reporting batch submits it to the authority and is a human review step (list_reporting_batches describes it as awaiting a human confirm). Do not add without a product decision.
hostedOnly.exclude_reporting_batch_item: Deliberately absent for the same reason as confirm_reporting_batch.
